name: Tunchang smart agriculture and agricultural-products big data center project
developer: Tunchang County / project sponsors not specified
notes: County press-conference material describes planning for a smart-agriculture and agricultural-products big data center; no MW/rack figures found.

name: Wenchang Space Supercomputing Center
developer: Wenchang Space Supercomputing Smart Technology / Wenchang International Aerospace City ecosystem
notes: CNSA announced the project as Wenchang aerospace information infrastructure with about 1,800 server cabinets and 2.5 PF initial planned host scale; later state media reported the center in operation with peak supercomputing capacity around 820 PFlops.

name: China StarNet Hainan Wenchang ground station and data center project
developer: China Satellite Network Group / Wenchang International Aerospace City partners
notes: Report citing Wenchang International Aerospace City management said the China StarNet Hainan Wenchang ground station and data center project started construction in June 2023.

name: Remote-sensing satellite application integrated information and service platform data application center
developer: Wenchang International Aerospace City / China National Space Administration satellite-data application partners
notes: CNSA reported structural topping-out for a Wenchang International Aerospace City project that includes a new data application center and satellite-data service equipment.

name: Baoding 01 Data Center
developer: CapitaLand / Haoyang Data
notes: CapitaLand lists Baoding 01 at 98,304 square meters with 65.5 MW IT power capacity; Haoyang describes Baoding No.1 as a Jing-Jin-Ji hub asset with about 2,000 cabinets built and 10,000-12,000 cabinets planned across five buildings.

name: China Mobile Data Center (Baoding)
developer: China Mobile Communications Group Hebei Branch
notes: Reported as a roughly RMB 1.5 billion China Mobile IDC project planned for more than 8,000 racks and described as supporting Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei integration.

name: Baidu AI Cloud Computing Center (Xushui and Dingxing / Baoding)
developer: Baidu
notes: Baidu and Baoding signed AI cloud-computing-center cooperation agreements for Xushui and Dingxing; Xushui government described the Xushui project as about 150 mu, 110,000 square meters and able to carry more than 120,000 high-performance AI servers.

name: Huawei Cangzhou Cloud Computing Center
developer: Cangzhou Municipal Government / Huawei
notes: Xinhua reported Cangzhou and Huawei signed a 2017 cloud-computing data-center strategic agreement and built Huawei Cangzhou Cloud Computing Center, supporting the municipal government cloud.

name: National Beidou Navigation Location Service Data Center Hebei Branch
developer: Hebei Beidou Data Technology / Cangzhou High-Tech Industrial Development Zone partners
notes: People's Daily Hebei reported the Hebei branch was unveiled in Cangzhou and formally completed/operational; local materials identify it as a representative strategic emerging-industry project.

name: Chengde Deming Big Data Industrial Park data center
developer: Beijing Supply and Marketing Big Data Group / Chengde partners
notes: Government and Xinhua-linked reporting describe a green data center in Chengde County with a long-term scale of about 20,000 cabinets; CAC reported two T3+ data centers delivered with 3,500 usable cabinets.

name: Chengde High-Tech Zone Digital Ecology Industrial Base
developer: Chengde High-Tech Zone / multiple project partners
notes: Chengde government described the high-tech-zone digital ecology industrial base as the core of a local compute pattern with Phicomm and Zhongjing Chengyuan data centers as wings; 2024 promotion materials introduced the base and related data-center cooperation projects.

name: Chengde Phicomm Big Data Project
developer: Shanghai Phicomm Data Communication Technology / Chengde High-Tech Zone
notes: Hebei industry authority reported a Chengde High-Tech Zone agreement with Shanghai Phicomm for a RMB 1.5 billion big-data project planned for 10,000 cabinets; later Chengde government material lists Phicomm Big Data Center as part of the city's compute layout.

name: Handan Digital Economy Industrial Park Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Handan Digital Economy Industrial Park / local government partners
notes: Xinhua Hebei reported the Handan Digital Economy Industrial Park intelligent computing center entered the construction stage and would support AI training, scientific computing, and big-data analysis for Handan and nearby areas.

name: Handan Smart City Big Data Center / Baidu Intelligent Cloud digital economy base
developer: Handan Municipal Government / Baidu
notes: Xinhua Finance reported Handan and Baidu signed a framework agreement to build a Handan smart-city big data center and Baidu Intelligent Cloud digital economy industrial base, including an intelligent computing center and AI data-labeling center.

name: Xiong'an (Hengshui) Advanced Supercomputing Center
developer: Chinese Academy of Sciences / Xiong'an New Area / Hengshui Municipal Government / Hengshui High-Tech Zone
notes: National Supercomputing Internet member profile says the center was jointly initiated by CAS, Xiong'an New Area and Hengshui and commercially operational from 2022-12-01, covering supercomputing, intelligent computing, cloud computing and big-data services.

name: Hengshui High-Tech Industrial Development Zone data center building project
developer: Hengshui High-Tech Industrial Development Zone
notes: Construction-bidding aggregator lists a proposed data-center building project in Hengshui High-Tech Industrial Development Zone; no official project page or capacity figure found.

name: Runze (Langfang) International Information Port
developer: Range Intelligent Computing Technology Group / Runze Technology
notes: Runze and Langfang government sources describe a hyperscale Langfang campus planned for about 20-22 high-grade data centers, around 1 million square meters of computer-room area and roughly 130,000 cabinets; multiple buildings are operational with others under construction.

name: Runze Artificial Intelligence Application Center B-1/B-2 intelligent computing centers
developer: Runze Technology / CSCEC Eighth Engineering Bureau
notes: CSCEC reported topping-out of B-1 and B-2 at Runze's AI application center in Langfang Economic-Technological Development Area, with 220,000 square meters total floor area and ability to gather over 100,000 AI accelerator cards after completion.

name: GDS Smart and Innovative Cloud Computing Data Center
developer: GDS Services
notes: GDS states its Smart and Innovative Cloud Computing Data Center is located in Langfang, Hebei, and was launched in March 2021 to serve high-performance internet enterprises.

name: Huawei Langfang Cloud Data Center
developer: Huawei
notes: Beijing E-Town report says phase 1 of Huawei's Langfang cloud data center, begun in July 2019, was put into use; government/CAC materials also identify Huawei as a Langfang Development Zone big-data anchor.

name: China Telecom Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Big Data Base
developer: China Telecom Group
notes: Huaxin Design Institute project page describes a Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Big Data Base with 164,415.2 square meters land area, 12 data centers totaling 312,700 square meters, and 3 power centers.

name: JD Group North China (Langfang) Cloud Data Center Base
developer: JD Group
notes: Project contractor page describes JD Group North China (Langfang) Cloud Data Center Base with total construction area of 136,019.27 square meters, developed in two phases with No. 1 and No. 2 data centers in phase one.

name: VNET N-HB / Langfang Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei regional data centers
developer: VNET Group
notes: VNET's Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei page lists operational and phased regional data centers in a data-center industry cluster; DC Atlas lists Langfang VNET Group 002 as operational with 15 MW live capacity.
